# opnsense_proxy_pac_rule (Data Source)

Rules of the proxy auto-config file (**Services ▸ Squid Web Proxy ▸ Proxy Auto Config ▸ Rules**). A rule sends clients to its proxies when its matches apply.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the PAC rule.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this rule is enabled.
- `join_type` (String) How the matches are combined.
- `match_type` (String) Use the proxies `if` the matches apply, or `unless` they do.
- `matches` (Set of String) IDs of `opnsense_proxy_pac_match` resources.
- `proxies` (Set of String) IDs of `opnsense_proxy_pac_proxy` resources, in order of preference.
